description:
EverCherish creates personalized memorial keepsakes and QR-connected tributes for people honoring loved ones and pets. Our products include memorial videos, wallet cards, engraved dog tags, slate plaques, and keepsake bundles.

Affiliates earn 5% commission on qualifying sales, receive 30-day referral tracking, and can be assigned a 5% customer discount code.

We are seeking creators and marketers who can introduce these meaningful products to U.S. audiences through authentic, respectful content. TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, blogs, social communities, and other appropriate organic promotional channels are welcome.

Complimentary personalized samples may be available to select qualified creators.

No spam, misleading promotion, unauthorized coupon-site distribution, trademark bidding, or unauthorized paid advertising.
payout_period: Monthly, by the 10th of the following month, after eligible referrals are reviewed and approved.
categories: Religious & Ceremonial, Animals & Pet Supplies, Services
term_and_condition:
EverCherish Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions

By applying to or participating in the EverCherish Affiliate Program, you agree to these Affiliate Terms & Conditions.

1. Affiliate Approval

Submission of an application does not guarantee acceptance into the EverCherish Affiliate Program. EverCherish reserves the right to approve, deny, suspend, or remove an affiliate at its discretion, including when promotional activity is inconsistent with our brand, these terms, or applicable law.

Affiliates participate as independent promoters and are not employees, agents, representatives, or legal partners of EverCherish.

2. Commission

Unless otherwise stated in your affiliate account or a separate written agreement, approved affiliates earn a 5% commission on qualifying referral sales attributed to their affiliate link or assigned coupon code.

Commission is calculated on the eligible merchandise value recorded by the affiliate tracking system after applicable discounts and excludes taxes, shipping charges, refunded amounts, canceled orders, chargebacks, fraudulent transactions, and other non-qualifying amounts.

Only one commission may be earned per qualifying order.

EverCherish may offer individual affiliates different commission rates, bonuses, or promotional terms through separate written offers or program tiers.

3. Referral Tracking

Affiliate referrals may be tracked through an assigned affiliate link, coupon code, or other tracking method provided through the EverCherish affiliate platform.

The standard referral tracking window is 30 days, unless otherwise stated in the affiliate account or a separate promotional offer.

Tracking and attribution are subject to the records generated by EverCherish's affiliate tracking platform. EverCherish may review referrals reasonably suspected of fraud, abuse, duplicate attribution, technical error, or violation of these terms.

4. Affiliate Coupons and Discounts

Affiliates may promote only coupon codes specifically assigned or authorized by EverCherish.

An affiliate may not create, alter, misrepresent, or distribute unauthorized EverCherish discount codes.

Affiliate-specific coupon codes may not be submitted to public coupon, deal, discount-code, or coupon-aggregation websites without prior written permission from EverCherish.

Customer discounts and promotional offers may be modified or discontinued prospectively by EverCherish.

5. Refunds, Cancellations, and Invalid Orders

Commissions are earned only on qualifying completed sales.

Commissions may be denied, reversed, or adjusted for orders that are canceled, refunded, charged back, fraudulent, duplicated, returned, otherwise invalid, or determined to result from prohibited affiliate activity.

6. Prohibited Affiliate Activity

Affiliates may not:

  • Make false, misleading, deceptive, or unsubstantiated claims about EverCherish or its products.

  • Represent themselves as EverCherish, an EverCherish employee, or an authorized company representative.

  • Use spam, unsolicited bulk messages, deceptive redirects, cookie stuffing, automated traffic, fraudulent orders, or other artificial means of generating referrals.

  • Purchase through their own affiliate link or coupon for the primary purpose of earning commission unless EverCherish provides written authorization.

  • Bid on the EverCherish name, EverCherish trademarks, myevercherish.com, misspellings or variations of the brand, or other EverCherish-branded terms through paid search advertising without prior written permission.

  • Register domains, social media accounts, advertisements, or profiles that impersonate or could reasonably be mistaken for official EverCherish properties.

  • Promote EverCherish through unlawful, hateful, sexually explicit, deceptive, exploitative, or otherwise inappropriate content.

  • Use grief, death, loss, or personal memorial circumstances in a deliberately deceptive, exploitative, or disrespectful manner to generate sales.

Paid advertising using EverCherish branding requires prior written approval.

7. Advertising Disclosures

Affiliates must clearly and conspicuously disclose their financial relationship with EverCherish whenever required by applicable advertising or endorsement laws.

Affiliate content should make it reasonably clear that the affiliate may receive compensation or commission from qualifying purchases. Affiliates are responsible for following applicable FTC endorsement requirements and the disclosure rules of the social media platforms they use.

8. Brand and Content Use

Approved affiliates may use EverCherish-approved product information, links, promotional materials, logos, and other brand assets solely for the purpose of promoting EverCherish while participating in the program.

EverCherish trademarks, images, copy, videos, and other materials may not be materially altered in a misleading manner or used in a way that suggests ownership, employment, sponsorship, or authorization beyond the affiliate relationship.

9. Payments

Approved commissions will become payable according to the payout process and schedule communicated through the affiliate platform or directly by EverCherish.

Affiliates are responsible for providing accurate payment and tax information when requested and are responsible for their own tax obligations arising from affiliate earnings.

10. Honest Endorsements

Affiliates must provide truthful opinions and may not claim personal experience with an EverCherish product or service that they have not actually had.

Nothing in this program requires an affiliate to provide a positive review or endorsement.

11. Termination

Either EverCherish or the affiliate may end the affiliate relationship at any time.

Termination does not automatically eliminate valid commissions earned before termination, but EverCherish reserves the right to deny commissions associated with fraud, prohibited activity, refunds, chargebacks, violations of these terms, or other non-qualifying transactions.

Upon termination, the affiliate must stop representing themselves as an active EverCherish affiliate and discontinue unauthorized use of EverCherish promotional materials.

12. Program Changes

EverCherish may modify affiliate commission rates, promotional offers, tracking rules, eligibility requirements, or these Affiliate Terms prospectively as the program evolves.

Material changes will apply going forward and will not be used to retroactively eliminate properly earned and otherwise valid commissions.

13. Acceptance

By submitting an affiliate application and participating in the EverCherish Affiliate Program, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to these Affiliate Terms & Conditions.
